name: Edric Vale
source_profile:
Captain Edric Vale: "The Last Loyal Man" (LN) 
Once the celebrated commander of the 4th Galrothe Foot, Edric 
Vale became famous for holding a strategic crossing against 
overwhelming royalist forces, allowing the remnants of a 
northern army and thousands of civilians to escape. 
When word came that the rebellion had been crushed, Vale 
refused to surrender. His men burned their regimental records, 
struck their lord's heraldry from their shields, and marched east 
beneath their tattered battle standard. 

Today, the Last Colours are among the most disciplined outlaw bands in the region. They raid 
royal tax caravans, steal military provisions, and occasionally hire themselves out to protect 
independent settlements. 
Vale continues to maintain that he is a soldier, not a bandit. He insists his men pay for food 
taken from farmers and forbids attacks on civilians. However, he has no compunction about 
killing royal officials or soldiers sent to capture him. 
Captain Edric Vale doesn't merely reject royal authority. He believes that the king has 
invalidated his oath by destroying the noble house to which it was sworn.  
Reputation: Among northern refugees, Vale is something of a folk hero. To the crown, he is a 
dangerous rebel whose refusal to surrender threatens the peace. 
Adventure hook: A village accused of harboring the Last Colours faces collective punishment 
from the local authorities. The villagers insist that Vale's men are the only reason their 
settlement survived the winter.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 34–35 (source excerpt)
